description: The nth Catalan number. C0 and C1 are 1, C2 is 2, C3 is 5, and C_n = binom(2n, n) / (n+1). n runs from 0 to 2048. An optional modulus reduces the term; zero is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/catalan
